All other shapes retain their source paths and timing inventory

controlled_experiment.design: Two-by-two admission policy x confirmation comparator, plus independently prepared scoredPW38 serving control. Do not combine factors before measuring each.
controlled_experiment.admission_factor_A: FrozenPW43v1 cumulative weighted deadline behavior, with its expired-search outcomes retained
controlled_experiment.admission_factor_B: Reserved admission accounting: all costly steps charged to one monotonic whole-Lt deadline; reserve remaining-cell minimum control/confirmation work before optional discovery; skip optional work before it consumes the next cell's reservation
controlled_experiment.comparator_factor_1: Actual independently prepared PW38 selected Lt configuration/layout plus torch reference, fresh-fixture balanced brackets; retain incumbent/candidate/default values separately
controls: Same actual GPU weights and physical device; every policy gets fresh independent state and its original clock
Balanced source-prepare order across repetitions; never choose favorable repetition or reset its clock
Use at least three complete prepare repetitions for admission/selection variability; predeclare stop/cap before launch
Common discovery-only candidate inventory per matched mechanism contrast; selection fixtures separate from final evaluation fixtures
Record actual PW38 algorithm configuration/layout dynamically and preserve original state for direct comparison
Resolve layout+configuration into each fresh module through legal lt_add; opaque algorithm codes are module-local and cannot be copied
Fullpolicy comparison uses each complete actual kernel_fn, including downstream RQ bake choices
No positive performance or promotion claim from only a fixed-configuration mechanism contrast
falsifiers: B reduces admission misses but not held-out fullpolicy loss: candidatequality remains deficient
B0 andB1 disagree with common discoverylist: comparator factor matters independently of admission
A1 remains incomplete whileB1 completes: admission mechanism is supported, not a blanketkernel claim
B1 loses/ties actualPW38 under balanced paired/F1 or official fullscore: retain version-scoped negative evidence, no promotion

production_comparator_boundary: Research wrapper can observe actualPW38 fullprepare state. Standalone serving prepare cannot silently borrow it or execute a hidden second prepare. An in-budget legacy-policy incumbent derived from shared search is only a proxy; implementer must label it and prove agreement/differences across repeated actualPW38 prepares before calling it actualincumbent. If that cannot fit, HOLD productionchange and keep experiment mechanism-only.

Per-cell enqueue/admission/start/end plus remaining wall and monotonic budgets

Input allocation/generation, FP32reference, Lt descriptor/heuristic initialization per layout, legality checks, lt_add/lt_cfg/caps, discoveryvalidation/timing, finalistfreeze, freshfixture creation/validation, confirmationtiming, decision and final selected fullpolicy
For each unit: scheduled estimate basis, actual start/end, budget before/after, complete/skipped/overrun and exact fallback reason
All raw discovery/confirmation/evaluation timings including tiny/tie/loss/invalid/partial; actual config/layout/source and selectedroute identity

decision_rule: Predeclare estimator and uncertainty rule before measurements. Preserve actualincumbent when incomplete/equivocal. A candidate must beat the actualincumbent on held-out samples, not merely torch. Keep every sign and both paired/F1 summaries without any0.3/0.5us retention gate. Full six-load score remains the promotion objective.
